note: All cases are visible development cases, not an independent holdout. Replay replies are synthetic fixed provider outputs, not measured model answers.

cases.question: 请核对百科，PLL 的定义是什么？纠正之前的说法。

replies.answer: PLL 是 Permutation of Last Layer，即顶层排列，不做朝向处理。[[wiki:2]]
